_comment: Every state in statemachine/validate_corpus.asl.json runs THIS task definition -- same image, same role, same EFS mount -- and picks which script to run via the ECS RunTask ContainerOverrides.Command. The EFS mount is not optional: Step Functions launches each script (01-10) as a separate Fargate task with its own throwaway container filesystem, so without a shared volume, 05_comprehend_language.py would never see the vision_title_check.csv that 04_bedrock_ocr.py wrote in a different task. Mounting the same EFS access point at the repo's data/ path on every task is what makes 10_validate_corpus.py's --in/--out file-based handoff between scripts work exactly the same way it does when you run them all in one process locally.
